spans.s:
रुश् रुश् (connected with and in some
forms and meanings identified with rt.
1. रुष्), cl. 6. P. रुशति, रुरोश, रोक्ष्यति,
अरुक्षत्, रोष्टुम्, to hurt, injure, kill; to vex,
displease, annoy: Caus. रोशयति, -यितुम्, Aor.
[]
अरूरुशत्: Desid. रुरुक्षति: Intens. रोरुश्यते,
रोरोष्टि.

रुष् 1. रुष् (connected with and in
some forms and meanings identified with
rt. रुश्; allied also to रुक्ष् in 1. रुक्ष), cl.
1. P. रोषति, रुरोष, रोषिष्यति, अरोषीत् or
अरुषत्, रोषितुम् or रोष्टुम्, to hurt, injure, kill;
to vex, annoy, displease, make angry, disgust; to
take ill, be offended (Ved.); cl. 4. रुष्यति, to be
vexed or annoyed; to be offended; to be cross or
angry; to injure, &c.: cl. 10. or Caus. रोषयति, -यि-
तुम्, Aor. अरूरुषत्, to vex, annoy, displease, irritate;
to enrage, exasperate: Desid. रुरुषिषति, रुरोषि-
षति: Intens. रोरुष्यते, रोरोष्टि; [cf. probably
Gr. λύσσα, λυσσάω, λυσσαίνω, (perhaps also) ἀλυσταίνω,
ἀλυκταίνω, ἀλαλὐκτημαι; Goth. in-rauht-
jan.]
2. रुष्, ट्, f. anger, wrath, rage, fury, passion.

रूष् रूष्, cl. 1. P. रूषति, &c., to
adorn, decorate; to cover, smear [cf. rt.
रूक्ष्, रूक्षित]; cl. 10. P. रूषयति, &c., to
tremble; to burst.

1. रुशत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, hurting, injuring,
vexing, displeasing; cursing, imprecating.

रुशत् 2. रुशत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत् (probably
to be regarded as a participle connected with rt.
1. रुच्), Ved. brilliant, bright, light-coloured, white;
[cf. Gr. λευκός]
—रुशत्-पशु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. having
white cattle; (Sāy.) having brilliant rays or blazing
with the oblation (= रुशद्-रश्मि or प्रकाशित-
हविस्).
—रुशद्-ऊर्मि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. having glis-
tening waves, having bright flames (said of Fire;
Sāy. = दीप्त-ज्वाल).
—रुशद्-गु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved.
having white or bright cattle; bright-rayed, (Sāy.
= रोचमान-रश्मि); (उस्), m. a proper N.
—रु-
शद्-रथ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having a light-coloured
carriage; (अस्), m. a proper N.
—रुशद्-वत्स, अस्, आ,
अम्, Ved. having a bright or white calf or offspring,
(the Dawn is so called as parent of the Sun.)

रुषत्, अन्, अन्ती or अती (as if fr. rt. रुश्), अत्,
hurting, injuring, vexing, displeasing.
—रुषद्-गु,
उस्, m., N. of a king.
रुशङ्गु रुशङ्गु, उस्, m., N. of a Ṛṣi.
रुषङ्गु, उस्, m., N. of a Brāhman.

रुशना रुशना, f., N. of one of the wives
of Rudra.

रुशम रुशम, अस्, m. a proper N.; (आ), f.
a proper N., (Ruśamā is said to have contended
with Indra as to which of the two would run fastest
round the earth, and to have won by the artifice of
only going round Kurukṣetra.)
रुशेकु रुशेकु, उस्, m., N. of a king.

रुषा, f. = 2. रुष्, anger, wrath, rage, fury.
—रुषान्वित (˚षा-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, filled with
anger, full of wrath.

रुषित, अस्, आ, अम्, injured; enraged, irritated,
&c., = रुष्ट below.

रूषित, अस्, आ, अम् (sometimes confounded with
रुषित, q. v.), adorned, decorated; perfumed; in-
laid; covered (with dust &c.), strewed, overspread,
soiled, besmeared, smeared [cf. rt. रूक्ष्, रूक्षित,
रुधिर-र्˚]; made rough or rugged [cf. रूक्ष];
pounded, (perhaps for रुषित.)

रुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, enraged, irritated, offended,
angry, furious; (अस्), m., N. of a Muni.

रुष्टि, इस्, f. anger, wrath, rage, fury, passion.
—रुष्टि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, angry, &c.

1. रुष्य, रुष्य-मत्, see Gaṇa Madhvādi to
Pāṇ.

2. रुष्य, ind. having irritated or enraged, &c.
(Rāmāyaṇa
रुष्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, being angry or offended.
रूषक, अस्, m. a plant, Gendarussa Vulgaris.

रूषण, अम्, n. the act of adorning, decoration;
covering, strewing, smearing, soiling.
